title: 七つの子 (Nanatsu no Ko — Seven Young Ones)
description: A beloved 1921 children's song about a crow calling from the mountains. The singer wonders why the crow cries — and the answer is that it has seven young ones waiting in the nest. The crow calls out 'kawaii kawaii' (how dear, how dear) because it loves its children so much. Old mountain nests, round eyes, the tender bond between parent and child — this gentle song captures a warmth that has made it a classic for a century.
